messages:
marta: Heads up — Dependabot flagged CVE-2025-1234 in tokenizers 0.13.2 (RCE via crafted tokenizer files). Patch available in 0.13.3. I started a lock update but CI started failing after resolving.
evans: CVSS and exploitability?
marta: CVSS 7.5, remote code execution when deserializing certain tokenizer metadata. Exploit requires uploading a malicious tokenizer file to a job path (low probability for hosted API but higher for private/on-prem where customers provide artifacts).
samir: Repro in CI: integration tests failing in text-gen smoke tests after poetry.lock bump. Error:
```
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x80 in position 12: invalid start byte
  File \"tests/integration/test_generation.py\", line 42, in test_generate
    out = client.generate(payload)
```
Looks like transformers/tokenizers binary wheel change -> different serialization behavior.
lee: Which deps moved? Did bumping tokenizers pull a new transformers or starlette indirectly?
marta: poetry resolved tokenizers -> 0.13.3, transformers pinned to 4.31.x, but starlette got bumped to 0.26.0 from 0.25.0 in the dependency tree when I let poetry do a full update. Starlette + fastapi 0.95.0 tests started failing in our test harness (uvicorn body parsing).
qa-bot: @marta created branch fix/cve-tokenizers-2025 and draft PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/fix/cve-tokenizers-2025 (draft)
evans: We need to triage impact & prioritization: hosted API (non-customer-uploaded tokens) vs Dedicated/Private where customers bring models. My read: high for private deployments, medium for hosted.
lee: Mitigation options
- Fast patch: pin tokenizers->0.13.3 and add strict deserialization check in our ingest code (validate tokenizer meta before load).
- Medium: release hotfix to hosted and dedicate a rolling update to Dedicated clusters.
- Long-term: add fuzzer test + CI gate against tokenizers deserialization.
samir: CI failure blocks merge. I suggest we do minimal lockfile edit: update tokenizers to 0.13.3 but constrain starlette back to 0.25.x to avoid burst of unrelated test regressions. Then run full smoke tests and canary deploy.
marta: Agreed. I'll update poetry.lock manually to prefer starlette 0.25.1 and pin transformers compatibility to 4.31.2. Also adding a quick sanitizer:
```
# in preprocess/tokenizer_loader.py
if meta.get(\'kind\') not in ALLOWED_TOKENIZER_KINDS:
    raise ValueError(\"invalid tokenizer metadata\")
```
ops-bot: CI pipeline triggered for fix/cve-tokenizers-2025 (job: security-scan, unit, integration-smoke, canary-deploy-sim)
qa-bot: Integration-smoke failed on one flaky spec; rerunning.
evans: Also log an incident note in the audit system and notify infra/security oncall. We should capture which customers run private deployments that could be affected.
lee: @marta can you add KMS/audit hook to ensure key rotations won't break token cache if we roll hotfix? I want to confirm that cached KV encryption keys are tolerant to rotation.
marta: Will check with infra: question for infra (cc @samir): does key rotation create a transient invalidation that would cause deserialization attempts to hit malformed payloads? If yes, we add defensive checks.
samir: Key rotation shouldn't change ciphertext format; but if a rotated key is missing in the node keyring during rollout it could cause decryption errors. We should tolerate decryption errors and fail-safe (reject) instead of attempting to deserialize.
lee: Ok plan:
1) Quick lockfile edit: tokenizers->0.13.3, pin starlette->0.25.x, transformers->4.31.2
2) Add deserialization whitelist + safe-fail on decrypt errors
3) Run full smoke + canary on hosted, then Dedicated scheduled hotfix
4) Postmortem + add fuzzer + CI gating
marta: I'll push the lockfile patch and sanitizer in the next 30m and request reviews from @evans @samir. If CI passes, we'll create a hotfix release branch and notify SRE for canary window.
evans: Thanks — mark priority as P1 for Private deployments, P2 for hosted. Also add a ticket in security board: SEC-4312.
ops-bot: Deployment pipeline queued.
qa-bot: rerun succeeded, integration-smoke green on second run.
marta: PR updated with pinned deps and sanitizer. Tagging for review.
lee: Great. After merge we should add a short playbook entry for tokenizer deserialization CVEs and include the KMS tolerance check in our runbook.
